t: Chapter 3 · Seven… Seven and a Half
b: Those under eighteen.. and those who are past the age but haven't come of age, skip this chapter…it's a bit indecent..they told me to write it uncensored

Because we booked the flight at the last minute, the price had shot sky-high.. We're people already beaten down by poverty.. So when they said it's cheaper if you go with only hand luggage, we decided to go like that.. Since the ones who'd gone already had lots of room in their bags, we decided that if we bought clothes and pots and pans there, we'd put them in their bags..

Apparently you can only take 7 kilos as hand luggage. They told us that if you're out by a whisker they'll send you back.. Apparently just the day before, a husband and wife went to catch a flight.. The wife's suitcase was too big so they didn't let her in.. While she stood there crying, the guy said bye and set off happily.. Our lot said he'd probably told her at home to change the bag.. she wouldn't have listened and stuffed everything in. That's why he didn't care and left.. Lucky our feminist girls weren't there… if they'd heard, they'd have branded them

What can you take in 7 kilos? For fourteen days I packed just fourteen pairs of underwear.. I put in fourteen lightweight shirts and shorts, and the rest of the bits and bobs, chargers and all, and the scale at home showed six kilos.. So I stuffed a huge pile of medicines in as well (if anyone there asks whether you studied medicine, you can scare them by showing the medicines, can't you)

Now, thinking it was seven kilos, I strolled into the airport and just casually weighed it at the entrance.. It shows 9 kilos.. The scale at home must have been broken for about ten years.. Not knowing that, Amma has kept it carefully all this time because it was bought in Dubai.. When I phoned and told her the scale's broken, she's still saying it must be their airport scale that's broken..

Now how do I cut two kilos.. His bag is at 7 kilos too.. In the end I couldn't see any other way ..I took five shirts and five shorts, went to the bathroom and started putting them on one over the other.. Waddling along somehow, I came and checked, and it was still a few grams over.. I took out all the medicine boxes, kept the pills and threw away the boxes, shaved it off ten grams at a time and somehow brought it down to seven kilos…Even so, in case he said there's too much clothing and told us to take it off and throw it away, we spread everything from the underwear up on the seat to decide what we could throw, and tied it in a bag.. Foreigners who've never seen Pettah must have seen something new.
The one with me was smart, so he'd put his clothes on like this at home and come..he came wearing all his clothes (underwear included) layer upon layer.. Compared with him, I was fine..
Having got past all these tangles and knots, we got our boarding passes and went to immigration
There too, people created just for us were waiting
